en.s: The Battle of Luoyang was fought between the state of Later Zhao against the state of Former Zhao from August 328 to 21 January 329 during the Sixteen Kingdoms period in China. It concluded in a decisive victory for the Later Zhao and the capture of the Former Zhao emperor, Liu Yao, all but ensuring the Later Zhao's domination over northern China for the next 19 years.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 328年8月至329年1月21日，后赵与前赵在中国十六国时期围绕洛阳交战。战役以后一场决定性胜利告终，后赵俘获前赵皇帝刘曜，几乎由此确立了此后19年对中国北方的统治。
zh.n: 此条记录的结束日期依据原文信息框。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: On 21 January 763, Ibrahim ibn Abdallah’s Alid forces fought the Abbasid army commanded by Isa ibn Musa at Bakhamra, in present-day Iraq. The Abbasids won, and Ibrahim was severely wounded. He died on February 14.

zh.s: 763年1月21日，易卜拉欣·伊本·阿卜杜拉率领的阿里派军队在今伊拉克巴哈姆拉，与伊萨·伊本·穆萨指挥的阿拔斯军交战。阿拔斯军获胜，易卜拉欣身受重伤，于2月14日去世。

en.s: The Battle of Desio was fought on 21 January 1277 between the Della Torre and Visconti families for the control of Milan and its countryside. The battlefield was located near the modern Desio, a commune outside the city in Lombardy, Northern Italy. Although generally considered one of the numerous minor battles fought in the 13th century in Italy during the Wars of the Guelphs and Ghibellines, it was in fact the conclusion of a long inner struggle for the possession of Milan, leading to the transformation of the former democratic regime into an aristocratic signoria.

zh.s: 1277年1月21日，德拉托雷家族与维斯孔蒂家族为争夺米兰及周边乡村的控制权，在今意大利北部伦巴第地区、米兰城外的德西奥附近交战。它通常被视为13世纪意大利归尔甫派与吉伯林派战争中众多小战役之一，但实际上终结了围绕米兰归属的长期内部斗争，使原本的民主政体转为贵族领主统治。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: On January 21, 1525, Conrad Grebel baptized George Blaurock in Zürich, in present-day Switzerland. Blaurock then baptized several others. These baptisms are widely treated as the beginning of the Anabaptist movement, although historians differ on whether it had a single origin.

zh.t: 苏黎世举行早期再洗礼
zh.s: 1525年1月21日，康拉德·格雷贝尔在今瑞士苏黎世为乔治·布劳罗克施洗，布劳罗克随后又为其他几人施洗。这次洗礼通常被视为再洗礼派运动的起点，但历史学者对这场运动是否只有一个源头仍有不同看法。

en.t: Religious procession held in Paris after the Affair of the Placards
en.s: On 21 January 1535, a large religious procession took place in Paris, France, as religious conflict grew following the Affair of the Placards.

zh.t: 标语事件后巴黎举行宗教游行
zh.s: 1535年1月21日，法国巴黎举行大型宗教游行。此前的标语事件加剧了当地的宗教冲突。

en.s: The Battle of Dobrynichi took place on 21 January 1605 between the armies of False Dmitry I and Fyodor Mstislavsky near the village of Dobrynichi (today's Bryansk Oblast in Russia).

zh.s: 1605年1月21日，假德米特里一世的军队与费奥多尔·姆斯季斯拉夫斯基的军队在多布雷尼奇村附近交战。该村位于今天俄罗斯布良斯克州境内。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The Battle of Sabana Real took place on January 21, 1691. An army of 700 Dominican raiders and 2,600 militiamen who had circled around Saint-Domingue aboard five warships of the Armada de Barlovento overwhelmed 1,000 French defenders at Sabana de la Limonade; Governor de Cussy and 400 of his followers were killed.

zh.s: 1691年1月21日，一支由700名多米尼加袭击者及2,600名民兵组成的军队，乘五艘巴洛文托舰队战舰绕行圣多明各后，在萨瓦纳德拉利莫纳德击败1,000名法国守军。德屈西总督及其400名部下阵亡。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: Sweden and Prussia sign the Treaty of Stockholm
en.s: The Treaties of Stockholm were two treaties signed in 1719 and 1720 that ended the war between Sweden and an alliance of Hanover and Prussia. Aspects of the conflict that remained unresolved would be dealt with by two further treaties, the Treaty of Frederiksborg between Sweden and Denmark-Norway in 1720 and the Treaty of Nystad between Sweden and Russia in 1721.

zh.t: 瑞典与普鲁士签署《斯德哥尔摩条约》
zh.s: 《斯德哥尔摩条约》由两份条约组成，分别于1719年和1720年签署，结束了瑞典与汉诺威、普鲁士联盟之间的战争。冲突中尚未解决的问题随后由另外两份条约处理：1720年瑞典与丹麦—挪威签署《腓特烈斯堡条约》，1721年瑞典与俄罗斯签署《尼斯塔德条约》。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.t: The Teatro Filarmonico in Verona is destroyed by fire, as a result of a torch being left behind in the box of a nobleman after a performance. It is rebuilt in 1754
en.s: The Teatro Filarmonico is the main opera theater in Verona, Italy, and is one of the leading opera houses in Europe. The Teatro Filarmonico is property of the Accademia Filarmonica di Verona. Having been built in 1716, and later rebuilt after a fire of January 21, 1749, and again after the allied bombing of February 23, 1945.

zh.t: 维罗纳爱乐剧院遭火灾焚毁
zh.s: 维罗纳爱乐剧院是意大利维罗纳的主要歌剧院，也是欧洲重要的歌剧院之一，隶属于维罗纳爱乐学院。剧院建于1716年，1749年1月21日曾遭火灾，之后于1754年重建；1945年2月23日又在盟军轰炸中受损并重建。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The Battle on Snowshoes (French: Bataille en raquettes) was a skirmish fought between Rogers' Rangers and Canadien and Indian troops during the French and Indian War on January 21, 1757. The battle was given this name because the British combatants wore snowshoes. On January 21, 1757, Captain Robert Rogers and a band of his rangers were on a scouting expedition near Fort Carillon on Lake Champlain when they were ambushed by a mixed troop of French regulars, Canadien militiamen, and Indians.

zh.s: 雪鞋战役又称“雪鞋之战”，是法国印第安战争期间的一场小规模交战，于1757年1月21日发生。英国士兵穿着雪鞋，因此得名。当天，罗伯特·罗杰斯上尉率领一队游骑兵在尚普兰湖卡里永堡附近侦察，途中遭到法国正规军、加拿大民兵和原住民士兵组成的混合部队伏击。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The 1789 South Carolina gubernatorial election was held on January 21, 1789, in order to elect the Governor of South Carolina. Candidate and former President of the South Carolina Senate Charles Pinckney was elected by the South Carolina General Assembly as he ran unopposed. The exact number of votes cast in this election is unknown.

zh.t: 1789年美国南卡罗来纳州州长选举
zh.s: 1789年1月21日，南卡罗来纳州举行州长选举。前州参议院议长查尔斯·平克尼因无人竞争，经州议会选举当选。此次选举的确切票数不详。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: Louis XVI, the deposed king of France, was publicly executed on 21 January 1793 during the French Revolution at the Place de la Révolution in Paris. At his trial four days prior, the National Convention had convicted Louis of high treason in a near-unanimous vote; while no one voted "not guilty", several deputies abstained. Ultimately, they condemned him to death by a simple majority of one vote.

zh.s: 1793年1月21日，法国大革命期间，被废黜的国王路易十六在巴黎革命广场被公开处决。四天前，国民公会审判他时，几乎一致判定其叛国罪成立：无人投“无罪”票，但有数名代表弃权。最终，死刑判决以仅一票的简单多数通过。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: The Battle of Mollet or the Action of Mollet took place at Mollet del Vallès, near Barcelona, in Catalonia, on 21 January 1810, between a force of 2,160 French soldiers commanded by General Guillaume Philibert Duhesme and a Spanish force of 3,000 men under Luis González Torres de Navarra, Marquess of Campoverde. The Spanish Division of Llobregat led by Campoverde intercepted and destroyed the French vanguard (500 men) at Santa Perpètua de Mogoda.

zh.s: 1810年1月21日，加泰罗尼亚巴塞罗那附近的莫列特德尔巴列斯爆发战斗。纪尧姆·菲利贝尔·迪埃姆将军指挥2,160名法军，对阵坎波韦尔德侯爵路易斯·贡萨雷斯·托雷斯·德·纳瓦拉的3,000名西军。侯爵率领的略夫雷加特师，在圣佩尔佩图阿德莫戈达截击并歼灭了500人的法军先头部队。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The Battle of Moquegua (or Moquehua) took place during the Peruvian War of Independence on 21 January 1823 around the city of Moquegua, between the Liberation Army of Peru, under command of Argentinean General Rudecindo Alvarado, and the Royal Army of Peru under General José de Canterac. The army of the Patriots was almost completely destroyed.

zh.s: 1823年1月21日，秘鲁独立战争中的莫克瓜战役，在该城周边展开。阿根廷将军鲁德辛多·阿尔瓦拉多指挥秘鲁解放军，迎战何塞·德·坎特拉克将军率领的秘鲁王家军，爱国派军队几乎全军覆没。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The Battle of Nsamankow was a battle between the United Kingdom and the Ashanti Empire that took place in 1824 as part of the First Anglo-Ashanti War. The British force under Charles MacCarthy was defeated by an Ashanti force.

zh.s: 恩萨曼科战役是英国与阿散蒂帝国之间的一场战斗，于1824年爆发，是第一次英阿散蒂战争的一部分。查尔斯·麦卡锡率领的英军被阿散蒂军队击败。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: On 21 January 1846, Sikh and British forces met near Baddowal, in present-day India, during the First Anglo-Sikh War. Sikh troops attacked Harry Smith’s baggage train as his column marched toward Ludhiana.

zh.s: 1846年1月21日，第一次英锡战争期间，锡克军与英军在今印度巴多瓦尔附近相遇。哈里·史密斯率部向卢迪亚纳行进时，锡克军袭击了他的辎重队。

en.s: The Antelope Hills expedition was a campaign from January to May 1858 by the Texas Rangers and members of other allied Native American tribes against Comanche and Kiowa villages in the Comancheria. It began in western Texas and ended in a series of fights with the Comanche tribe on May 12, 1858, at a place called Antelope Hills by Little Robe Creek, a tributary of the Canadian River in what is now Oklahoma.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 羚羊山远征是得克萨斯游骑兵与其他原住民盟友于1858年1月至5月发起的一场军事行动，目标是科曼奇亚地区的科曼奇人和基奥瓦人村落。远征从得克萨斯西部出发，最终在1858年5月12日于羚羊山附近小袍溪一带与科曼奇人发生多次交战。小袍溪是加拿大河的一条支流，位于今天的俄克拉何马州。
zh.n: 此条记录的开始日期依据原文信息框。

en.t: 1873 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1873 United States Senate election in New York was held on January 21, 1873, by the New York State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 3) to represent the State of New York in the United States Senate.

zh.t: 1873年美国纽约州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1873年1月21日，纽约州议会举行联邦参议员选举，选出该州第三组参议员席位的代表。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.t: 1879 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1879 United States Senate election in New York was held on January 21, 1879, by the New York State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 3) to represent the State of New York in the United States Senate.

zh.t: 1879年美国纽约州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1879年1月21日，纽约州议会举行联邦参议员选举，选出该州第三组参议员席位的代表。

en.s: The Battle of Mulayda was the last major battle during the period of the Second Saudi State which occurred on 21 January 1891 over issues regarding zakat and the arrest of the Rashidi leader. The Rashidis plotted to end the Saudi state and conquer both the Qassim region and Riyadh.

zh.s: 1891年1月21日，第二沙特王国时期的最后一场重要战役在穆莱达展开，起因涉及天课缴纳及拉希德家族首领遭逮捕的问题。拉希德家族计划终结沙特政权，并夺取卡西姆地区与利雅得。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The Rio de Janeiro Affair refers to a series of incidents during the Brazilian Naval Revolt in January 1894. Following three attacks on American merchant ships in the harbour of Rio de Janeiro, a bloodless naval engagement occurred between a United States Navy warship and an ironclad of Rear Admiral Saldanha da Gama's rebel fleet.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: “里约热内卢事件”指1894年1月巴西海军叛乱期间发生的一系列事件。美国商船在里约热内卢港遭袭三次后，美国海军军舰与海军少将萨尔达尼亚·达伽马的叛军舰队中的一艘铁甲舰发生海战，但没有人员伤亡。
zh.n: 此条记录的结束日期依据原文信息框。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The siege of Mekelle, sometimes known as the battle of Mekelle, took place in January 1896 during the First Italo-Ethiopian War. Italian forces surrendered a partially completed fort at Mekelle, a city in the northern Tigray Region of Ethiopia which they had occupied since 1895, to Ethiopian forces.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 梅克埃莱围城战有时也称梅克埃莱战役，发生于1896年1月，是第一次意大利—埃塞俄比亚战争的一部分。意大利军队向埃塞俄比亚军队投降，交出梅克埃莱的一座尚未完工的堡垒。意军自1895年起占领这座城市；它位于埃塞俄比亚北部提格雷地区。
zh.n: 此条记录的结束日期依据原文信息框。

en.t: 1902 United States Senate election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1902 United States Senate election in Kentucky was held on January 21, 1902, after an initial election on January 14, 1902. Democratic candidate James B. McCreary was elected by the Kentucky General Assembly to the United States Senate, defeating incumbent Republican senator William J. Deboe. The election was held twice due to ambiguity in the law setting the election date.

zh.t: 1902年美国肯塔基州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1902年1月21日，肯塔基州举行联邦参议员选举，民主党候选人詹姆斯·B.麦克里里经州议会选举，击败共和党籍现任威廉·J.德博当选。此前1月14日已举行过一次选举，但规定日期的法律含糊，因此又投票一次。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The January 1908 Irish representative peer election was held to fill a vacancy among the 28 Irish representative peers at that time elected to the British House of Lords. Conducted by post, with ballots sent to the 134 holders of Irish peerages eligible to vote, the election was necessitated by the death of Francis Browne, 4th Baron Kilmaine. It resulted in the election of Lord Curzon, the former viceroy of India.

zh.s: 1908年1月举行的爱尔兰代表贵族选举，是为了填补英国上议院28名爱尔兰代表贵族中的一个空缺。选举以邮寄方式进行，134名有投票资格的爱尔兰贵族收到选票。此次选举因第四代基尔梅恩男爵弗朗西斯·布朗去世而举行，最终选出曾任印度总督的寇松勋爵。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: Kiwanis International is founded in Detroit
en.s: Kiwanis International ( ki-WAH-nis) is an international service club founded in 1915 in Detroit, Michigan. It is headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, United States, and is found in more than 80 nations and geographic areas. In 1987, the organization began to accept women as members. Kiwanis and its affiliated clubs have more than 600,000 members. Kiwanis clubs raise over $100 million each year and report over 18.5 million volunteer hours to strengthen communities and serve children.

zh.t: 国际基瓦尼斯组织在底特律成立
zh.s: 国际基瓦尼斯组织是一个国际服务社团，1915年在美国密歇根州底特律成立，总部位于印第安纳州印第安纳波利斯，在80多个国家和地区开展活动。该组织于1987年开始接纳女性会员。基瓦尼斯及其附属俱乐部共有60多万名会员，每年筹集超过1亿美元，并报告称每年提供超过1850万小时的志愿服务，以加强社区建设、服务儿童。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The First Battle of Hanna (Turkish: Felahiye Muharebesi) was a World War I battle fought on the Mesopotamian front on 21 January 1916 between Ottoman Army and Anglo-Indian forces.

zh.s: 1916年1月21日，第一次世界大战美索不达米亚战线上，奥斯曼军队与英印军在汉纳交战。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1916 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final was the 29th All-Ireland Final and the culmination of the 1916 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship, an inter-county hurling tournament for the top teams in Ireland. The match was held at Croke Park, Dublin, on 21 January 1917 between Kilkenny, represented by club side Tullaroan, and Tipperary, represented by club side Boherlahan.

zh.t: 1916年度全爱尔兰成年组板棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1917年1月21日，第29届全爱尔兰成年组板棍球锦标赛决赛，在都柏林克罗克公园举行，为1916年度赛事决出冠军。该赛事由爱尔兰顶尖郡队参加，本场由塔拉罗恩俱乐部代表基尔肯尼，对阵由博赫拉汉俱乐部代表的蒂珀雷里。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The Irish War of Independence (Irish: Cogadh na Saoirse) or Anglo-Irish War was a guerrilla war fought from 1919 to 1921 between the Irish Republican Army (IRA, the army of the Irish Republic) and the British security forces in Ireland. It was an escalation of the Irish revolutionary period into armed conflict. In the December 1918 election, the Irish republican party Sinn Féin won a landslide victory in Ireland. On 21 January 1919 they formed a breakaway government (Dáil Éireann) and declared independence from Britain. Later that day, two members of the armed police force, the Royal Irish Constabulary (RIC), were shot dead in County Tipperary by IRA members acting on their own initiative.

zh.s: 1919至1921年，爱尔兰共和军，即爱尔兰共和国的军队，与驻爱尔兰英国安全部队展开游击战争，也称英爱战争。这标志着爱尔兰革命时期的斗争升级为武装冲突。1918年12月选举中，主张共和的新芬党在爱尔兰大胜。1919年1月21日，他们成立独立议会政府，宣布脱离英国。同一天稍晚，两名皇家爱尔兰警察成员，在蒂珀雷里郡被自行采取行动的共和军成员枪杀。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Soloheadbeg ambush was the ambush of a gelignite transport at Soloheadbeg, County Tipperary, Ireland, on 21 January 1919 in which two policemen were killed. It is considered to be the first engagement of the Irish War of Independence.

zh.s: 1919年1月21日，爱尔兰蒂珀雷里郡索洛黑德贝格一支运送胶质炸药的队伍遭伏击，两名警察死亡。这被视为爱尔兰独立战争的首次交战。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Declaration of Independence (Irish: Forógra na Saoirse, French: Déclaration d'indépendance) was a document adopted by Dáil Éireann, the revolutionary parliament of the Irish Republic, at its first meeting in the Mansion House, Dublin, on 21 January 1919. It followed from the Sinn Féin election manifesto of December 1918. Texts of the declaration were adopted in three languages: Irish, English and French.

zh.s: 1919年1月21日，爱尔兰共和国革命议会在都柏林市长官邸举行首次会议，通过《独立宣言》。宣言承接新芬党1918年12月的竞选纲领，并同时通过爱尔兰语、英语及法语三个文本。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: Battle of Shekar Yazi (Kurdish: شەڕی شەکەریاز, romanized: Şeřî Şekeriyaz) took place on 21 January 1920 between the forces of Simko Shikak, a Kurdish tribal leader, and the government of Iran. This confrontation was part of the broader Kurdish uprisings in early 20th-century Iran, during a period marked by regional unrest and efforts by Kurdish leaders to assert autonomy.

zh.s: 谢卡尔亚齐战役（库尔德语：شەڕی شەکەریاز；转写：Şeřî Şekeriyaz）于1920年1月21日爆发，交战双方是库尔德部族领袖西姆科·希卡克率领的部队和伊朗政府军。这场冲突属于20世纪初伊朗库尔德人起义的一部分，当时该地区局势动荡，库尔德领导人也在争取自治。

en.s: The Drumcondra ambush (Irish: Luíochán Dhroim Conrach) was an attempted ambush carried out by the Irish Republican Army (IRA) in Drumcondra, a suburb in northern Dublin, during the Irish War of Independence. On 21 January 1921, an IRA active service unit (ASU) initially set up an ambush near the Royal Canal in preparation for a British lorry which was travelling through the area.

zh.s: 德拉姆康德拉伏击（爱尔兰语：Luíochán Dhroim Conrach）是爱尔兰共和军在爱尔兰独立战争期间实施的一次伏击行动，地点在都柏林北部郊区德拉姆康德拉。1921年1月21日，一支爱尔兰共和军现役部队最初在皇家运河附近设伏，准备袭击一辆经过当地的英国军用卡车。

en.t: Finland and the Soviet Union conclude a non-aggression treaty
en.s: On 21 January 1932, Finland and the Soviet Union concluded a non-aggression treaty.

zh.t: 芬兰与苏联缔结互不侵犯条约
zh.s: 1932年1月21日，芬兰与苏联缔结互不侵犯条约。

en.s: The Louisiana gubernatorial election of 1936 was held on January 21, 1936. Like most Southern states between Reconstruction and the civil rights era, Louisiana's Republican Party was virtually nonexistent in terms of electoral support. This meant that the Democratic Party primary held on this date was the real contest over who would be governor. The election resulted in the victory of Richard W. Leche of New Orleans as governor. Leche was supported by the Longite faction of the party and Cleveland Dear of Alexandria by the anti-Longs' "Home Rule" ticket.

zh.t: 1936年美国路易斯安那州州长选举
zh.s: 1936年1月21日，路易斯安那州举行州长选举。与重建时期至民权运动年代之间多数南方州一样，该州共和党几乎没有选举支持，因此当天民主党初选才是真正决定州长人选的角逐。新奥尔良的理查德·W.莱奇获胜。莱奇得到党内支持休伊·朗派系的支持，亚历山德里亚的克利夫兰·迪尔则代表反朗派的“地方自治”阵营。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador on 21 January 1939. The election was indirect rather than being held through a popular vote. The National Constitutional Assembly elected Brigadier General Maximiliano Hernández Martínez, the incumbent president of El Salvador, to a third presidential term that would last from 1939 to 1945. He was the only candidate and won unopposed.

zh.s: 1939年1月21日，萨尔瓦多举行间接总统选举，而非民众直接投票。国民制宪大会选出现任总统马克西米利亚诺·埃尔南德斯·马丁内斯准将，开始1939至1945年的第三个总统任期。他是唯一候选人，因无人竞争而当选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The Legionnaires' rebellion and the Bucharest pogrom occurred in Bucharest, Romania, between 21-23 January 1941. As the privileges of the paramilitary organization Iron Guard were being cut off gradually by the Conducător Ion Antonescu, members of the Iron Guard, also known as the Legionnaires, revolted. During the rebellion and pogrom the Iron Guard killed 125 Jews, and 30 soldiers died in the confrontation with the rebels. Following it, the Iron Guard movement was banned and 9,000 of its members were imprisoned.

zh.t: 铁卫团叛乱与布加勒斯特反犹屠杀
zh.s: 1941年1月21日至23日，罗马尼亚布加勒斯特爆发铁卫团叛乱及反犹屠杀。随着领袖扬·安东内斯库逐步削减准军事组织铁卫团的特权，其成员，也称军团分子，发动叛乱。期间铁卫团杀害125名犹太人，另有30名士兵在与叛军交战中死亡。事后，铁卫团被取缔，9,000名成员被监禁。

en.t: The Jewish resistance organization, Fareynikte Partizaner Organizatsye, based in the Vilna Ghetto is established
en.s: The Fareynikte Partizaner Organizatsye (Yiddish: פֿאַראײניקטע פּאַרטיזאַנער אָרגאַניזאַציע; "United Partisan Organization"; referred to as FPO by its Yiddish initials) was a Jewish resistance organization based in the Vilna Ghetto in German-occupied Lithuania and founded on 21 January 1942. The clandestine organisation was established by Communists as well as left- and right-wing Zionists. Their leaders were the communist Yitzhak Wittenberg, socialist Abba Kovner, and revisionist Betar member Josef Glazman.

zh.t: 维尔纳犹太人区联合游击队组织成立
zh.s: 联合游击队组织（意第绪语：פֿאַראײניקטע פּאַרטיזאַנער אָרגאַניזאַציע；意为“联合游击队组织”，按意第绪语缩写称FPO）是一个犹太抵抗组织，活动于德军占领下的立陶宛维尔纳犹太人区，成立于1942年1月21日。组织成员包括共产主义者，以及左翼和右翼犹太复国主义者。领导人有共产主义者伊扎克·维滕贝格、社会主义者阿巴·科夫纳和修正主义贝塔尔成员约瑟夫·格拉兹曼。

en.s: Sonderkommando Blaich (Special Command Blaich) was a German unit consisting of a Heinkel He 111H medium bomber supported by an Italian Savoia-Marchetti SM.82 (Marsupiale) transport aircraft and a Messerschmitt Bf 108B (Taifun). In January 1942 the Heinkel raided the Free French–controlled Fort Lamy (now N'Djamena) in the Chad region of French Equatorial Africa.

zh.s: 布莱希特特别行动队是德国的一支小部队，由一架亨克尔He 111H中型轰炸机，以及为其提供支援的意大利萨伏亚-马尔凯蒂SM.82“有袋动物”运输机和梅塞施密特Bf 108B“台风”飞机组成。1942年1月，亨克尔轰炸机袭击了由自由法国控制的拉米堡（今恩贾梅纳），地点在法属赤道非洲的乍得地区。

en.s: The Battle of Trnovo was a battle between Slovene partisans and Italian Social Republic troops. It took place between January 19–21, 1945 in Slovene Littoral.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 特尔诺沃战役是斯洛文尼亚游击队与意大利社会共和国军队之间的一场战斗，于1945年1月19日至21日在斯洛文尼亚沿海地区发生。
zh.n: 此条记录的结束日期依据原文信息框。

en.t: First trade union congress of Transcarpathian Ukraine
en.s: On January 21, 1945, the First Congress of Trade Unions of Transcarpathian Ukraine met in a cinema in Mukachevo, in present-day Ukraine. Delegates attended from all twelve districts of Transcarpathian Ukraine.

zh.t: 外喀尔巴阡乌克兰首届工会代表大会召开
zh.s: 1945年1月21日，外喀尔巴阡乌克兰首届工会代表大会在今乌克兰穆卡切沃的一家电影院召开。当地全部12个区均派代表参加。

en.t: Campaign to the South of Baoding
en.s: The Campaign to the South of Baoding consisted of several battles fought in regions south of Baoding between the nationalists and the communists during the Chinese Civil War after World War II, and resulted in the communist victory.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 保定以南战役是中国抗日战争结束后、国共内战期间的一系列战斗，交战双方为国民党军和共产党军。战役发生在保定以南地区，最终以共产党军获胜告终。
zh.n: 此条记录的开始日期依据原文信息框。

en.s: On 21 January 1951, Mount Lamington in present-day Papua New Guinea had a major explosive eruption. Devastating pyroclastic surges swept across nearby settlements. This was the climactic eruption, following earlier activity in January.

zh.t: 拉明顿火山发生大规模喷发
zh.s: 1951年1月21日，今巴布亚新几内亚的拉明顿火山发生大规模爆炸性喷发，火山碎屑流摧毁附近聚落。这是当月较早的火山活动之后最猛烈的一次喷发。

en.s: On 21 January 1954, USS Nautilus, the world’s first nuclear-powered submarine, was christened and launched into the Thames River in Connecticut, United States. Mamie Eisenhower sponsored the ship. It was commissioned on September 30 that year.

zh.s: 1954年1月21日，世界首艘核动力潜艇“鹦鹉螺”号在美国康涅狄格州泰晤士河举行命名和下水仪式，玛米·艾森豪威尔担任命名人。该艇于同年9月30日服役。

en.s: The battle of the borders, also known as the battle of the frontiers, was a group of military operations initiated mainly on the Algeria-Tunisia border during the Algerian War, from 21 January to 28 May 1958, by the paratrooper units of the French army against the attacks, and bombardments of the Morice Line by the combatants of the Armée de libération nationale (ALN), the military branch of the FLN, stationed in Tunisia.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 边境战役（阿尔及利亚战争）
zh.s: 边境战役又称前线战役，是阿尔及利亚战争期间的一系列军事行动，主要发生在阿尔及利亚与突尼斯边境。法国军队伞兵部队于1958年1月21日至5月28日发起行动，目标是打击驻扎在突尼斯的民族解放军武装人员。他们曾袭击并轰炸莫里斯防线。民族解放军是民族解放阵线的军事组织。
zh.n: 此条记录的开始日期依据原文信息框。

en.s: The worst mining disaster in South Africa occurred in the Coalbrook coal mine of Clydesdale Colliery on 21 January 1960 at around 19:00 when cave in occurred about 180 metres underground. About 1 000 miners were in the mine at the time and 435 were trapped. Immediately after the incident, rescue teams arrived from other mines in the region and boreholes were drilled into areas where survivors were expected to be. But when microphones were lowered no signs of life were detected, there were no survivors. After 11 days the rescue was called off.

zh.s: 1960年1月21日约19时，南非克莱兹代尔煤矿公司的科尔布鲁克矿井，在地下约180米处塌方，成为该国最严重的矿难。当时约1,000名矿工在井下，435人被困。周边矿井救援队立即赶到，在可能有生还者的地方钻孔，但把麦克风放入后，没有探测到生命迹象，最终无人幸存。救援持续11天后终止。

en.s: Avianca Flight 671, registration HK-177, was a Lockheed Constellation that crashed and burned on landing at Montego Bay Airport, Montego Bay, Jamaica, on 21 January 1960. The flight had originated at Miami International Airport, Florida. The aircraft operating the flight was a Lockheed L-1049E Super Constellation used by Avianca for its Bogotá-Montego Bay routes. Thirty-seven of the 46 passengers and crew aboard were killed.

zh.t: 哥伦比亚航空671号班机空难
zh.s: 1960年1月21日，哥伦比亚航空671号班机，在牙买加蒙特哥贝机场降落时坠毁起火，机上46名乘客和机组人员中有37人遇难。执飞飞机为洛克希德L-1049E“超级星座”，注册编号HK-177。该航班从美国佛罗里达州迈阿密国际机场出发，飞机平时用于哥伦比亚航空的波哥大—蒙特哥贝航线。

en.s: The 1962 African Cup of Nations final was a football match that took place on 21 January 1962 at the Hailé Sélassié Stadium in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, to determine the winner of the 1962 African Cup of Nations, the football championship of Africa organized by the Confederation of African Football (CAF). Ethiopia beat United Arab Republic 4−2 after extra time, winning their first title.

zh.s: 1962年1月21日，非洲国家杯决赛在埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴的海尔·塞拉西体育场举行，决出非洲足联主办的本届非洲足球锦标赛冠军。埃塞俄比亚在加时赛后以4比2击败阿拉伯联合共和国，首次夺冠。

en.t: North Shore Line ends passenger service
en.s: On January 21, 1963, the Chicago North Shore and Milwaukee Railroad ended its passenger service in the United States. Its last full day of service was January 20, with the final trains arriving early the next morning; some freight movements continued afterward.

zh.s: 1963年1月21日，美国芝加哥北岸与密尔沃基铁路停止客运。1月20日是最后一个完整运营日，末班列车于次日凌晨抵达终点。此后仍有少量货运作业。

en.s: General elections were held in Northern Rhodesia on 20 and 21 January 1964. There were two voter rolls for the Legislative Council, a main roll that elected 65 seats, and a reserved roll that elected 10. Africans elected the main roll, whilst Europeans elected the reserve roll. Other ethnicities were allowed to choose which roll to be part of.

zh.s: 北罗得西亚于1964年1月20日和21日举行大选。立法会选民分为两组：主要选民册选出65个席位，保留选民册选出10个席位。非洲人登记在主要选民册，欧洲人登记在保留选民册；其他族群可以自行选择登记在哪一册。

en.s: The Leyton by-election, 1965 was a parliamentary by-election held on 21 January 1965 for the British House of Commons constituency of Leyton in east London. The seat had become vacant when the constituency's long-serving Labour Member of Parliament (MP), Reginald Sorensen, was made a life peer on 15 December 1964. An MP for over thirty years, his elevation to the peerage was intended to create a vacancy in a safe seat for the Foreign Secretary, Patrick Gordon Walker, who had been defeated in a shock result in the 1964 general election in his Smethwick constituency.

zh.s: 1965年1月21日，伦敦东部莱顿下议院选区举行补选。长期担任该区工党议员的雷金纳德·索伦森，于1964年12月15日获封终身贵族，留下议席空缺。他已任议员三十多年，此次晋封是为了在工党稳胜选区制造空缺，让外交大臣帕特里克·戈登·沃克重新进入下议院。沃克在1964年大选中于斯梅西克选区意外落败。

en.s: On 21 January 1968, an aircraft accident, sometimes known as the Thule affair or Thule accident (; Danish: Thuleulykken), involving a United States Air Force (USAF) B-52 bomber occurred near Thule Air Base in the Danish territory of Greenland. The aircraft was carrying four B28FI thermonuclear bombs on a Cold War "Chrome Dome" alert mission over Baffin Bay when a cabin fire forced the crew to abandon the aircraft before they could carry out an emergency landing at Thule Air Base.

zh.t: 1968年图勒空军基地B-52轰炸机坠毁事故
zh.s: 1968年1月21日，一架美国空军B-52轰炸机在丹麦属地格陵兰的图勒空军基地附近发生事故，有时也称“图勒事件”或“图勒事故”（丹麦语：Thuleulykken）。飞机当时执行冷战时期的“铬穹”警戒任务，在巴芬湾上空巡逻，机上载有4枚B28FI型热核炸弹。机舱起火后，机组人员被迫弃机，无法按计划在图勒空军基地紧急降落。

en.s: The Battle of Khe Sanh (21 January – 9 July 1968) was conducted in the Khe Sanh area of northwestern Quảng Trị Province, Republic of Vietnam (South Vietnam), during the Vietnam War. The main forces defending Khe Sanh Combat Base (KSCB) were a regiment of the United States Marine Corps and a battalion of Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN) troops.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 溪山村战役于1968年1月21日至7月9日在越南共和国（南越）广治省西北部溪山地区进行，是越南战争的一部分。守卫溪山战斗基地的主力包括一支美国海军陆战队团和一支越南共和国陆军营。
zh.n: 此条记录的开始日期依据原文信息框。

en.s: Iran Air Flight 291 was a charter flight from Mashad Airport to Tehran-Mehrabad Airport. On 21 January 1980, the Boeing 727-86 during its approach crashed on the Tehran-Mehrabad runway 29 in foggy and snowy weather conditions, killing all 128 people on board. At the time, Iran Air Flight 291 was the deadliest aircraft disaster in Iranian history.

zh.s: 伊朗航空291号班机是从马什哈德飞往德黑兰梅赫拉巴德机场的包机。1980年1月21日，执飞的波音727-86在雾雪天气中进近梅赫拉巴德29号跑道时坠毁，机上128人全部遇难。当时这是伊朗历史上死亡人数最多的空难。

en.s: Kerala held its Legislative Assembly election on 21 January 1980. E. K. Nayanar took office as Chief Minister on 25 January 1980. The polling date and the subsequent swearing-in are separate milestones.
en.n: The official election report gives January 21 as polling day in all 140 constituencies. The earlier January 5 entry has been corrected.

zh.s: 喀拉拉邦于1980年1月21日举行邦议会选举。E. K. 纳亚纳尔于同年1月25日就任首席部长。投票日与随后宣誓就职的日期是两个不同的节点。
zh.n: 官方选举报告将全部140个选区的投票日列为1月21日。此前放在1月5日的记录已更正。

en.s: Galaxy Airlines Flight 203 was a non-scheduled charter flight of a Lockheed L-188A Electra from Reno to Minneapolis which crashed shortly after taking off from Reno-Tahoe International Airport on 21 January 1985. All but 1 of the 71 on board died. It was the first major air disaster in the U.S in 1985 and the deadliest since the crash of Pan Am Flight 759 in 1982.

zh.s: 1985年1月21日，银河航空203号非定期包机，从美国里诺—太浩国际机场起飞后不久坠毁。执飞飞机为洛克希德L-188A“伊莱克特拉”，原定从里诺飞往明尼阿波利斯，机上71人仅一人生还。这是美国1985年首起重大空难，也是1982年泛美航空759号班机事故以来死亡人数最多的一起。

en.s: The newspaper Zili Zaobao began publication following the lifting of restrictions on the establishment of newspapers in Taiwan.

zh.s: 台湾取消报纸创办限制后，《自由晚报》开始发行。

en.s: The ninth legislative assembly election of Tamil Nadu was held on 21 January 1989. Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) won the election and its leader M. Karunanidhi, became the Chief Minister. It was his third term in office. The DMK was in power only for a short term, as it was dismissed on 31 January 1991 by the Indian Prime minister Chandra Shekhar using Article 356 of the Indian Constitution.

zh.t: 1989年印度泰米尔纳德邦议会选举
zh.s: 1989年1月21日，泰米尔纳德邦举行第九届立法议会选举，达罗毗荼进步联盟获胜，其领袖M.卡鲁纳尼迪第三次出任首席部长。但该党此次执政时间不长，印度总理钱德拉·谢卡尔于1991年1月31日依据宪法第356条，解散其邦政府。

en.s: The 1990 Royal Rumble was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE). It was the third annual Royal Rumble event and took place on January 21, 1990, at the Orlando Arena in Orlando, Florida. It centered on the men's Royal Rumble match, a modified 30-man battle royal in which the participants enter at timed intervals instead of all beginning in the ring at the same time.

zh.s: 1990年1月21日，世界摔角联盟（WWF，现为WWE）在美国佛罗里达州奥兰多竞技场，举办第三届年度“皇家大战”按次付费赛事。核心项目是男子皇家大战，这是一种30人混战变体：选手按固定间隔依次入场，而非同时开始。

en.s: The 1996 Royal Rumble was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE). It was the ninth annual Royal Rumble event and took place on January 21, 1996, at the Selland Arena in Fresno, California. The event was based around the men's Royal Rumble match, a modified 30-man battle royal in which the participants enter at timed intervals instead of all beginning in the ring at the same time and the winner received a WWF Championship match at WrestleMania XII.

zh.s: 1996年1月21日，世界摔角联盟（WWF，现为WWE）在美国加利福尼亚州弗雷斯诺的塞兰德竞技场，举办第九届年度“皇家大战”按次付费赛事。核心项目是男子皇家大战，这是一种30人混战变体：选手按固定间隔依次入场，而非同时开始。胜者可在第12届摔角狂热挑战WWF冠军。

en.s: The 1996 CONCACAF Gold Cup final was a soccer match to determine the winners of the 1996 CONCACAF Gold Cup. The match was held at the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum in Los Angeles, United States, on January 21, 1996, and was contested by the winners of the semi-finals, Brazil and Mexico. Mexico, who had won 1993 CONCACAF Gold Cup, successfully defended their title with a 2–0 win over Brazil.

zh.t: 1996年中北美及加勒比海金杯赛决赛
zh.s: 1996年1月21日，中北美及加勒比海金杯赛决赛，在美国洛杉矶纪念体育场举行，由半决赛胜出的巴西与墨西哥争冠。1993年冠军墨西哥以2比0击败巴西，成功卫冕。

en.s: Royal Rumble (2001) was the fourteenth annual Royal Rumble professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF). It was presented by MCI's 1-800-COLLECT and took place on January 21, 2001, at the New Orleans Arena in New Orleans, Louisiana. The main event was the Royal Rumble match, which Stone Cold Steve Austin won by last eliminating Kane to win the match, making it his third Royal Rumble win. The match also included comedian Drew Carey. On the undercard, Kurt Angle defended the WWF World Heavyweight Championship against Triple H and Chris Jericho defeated Intercontinental Champion Chris Benoit in a ladder match.

zh.s: 2001年1月21日，世界摔角联盟（WWF）在美国路易斯安那州新奥尔良竞技场，举办第14届年度“皇家大战”按次付费赛事，由MCI的1-800-COLLECT业务冠名呈现。压轴皇家大战中，“冷石”史蒂夫·奥斯汀最后淘汰凯恩，第三次赢得皇家大战，喜剧演员德鲁·凯里也有参赛。其他比赛包括科特·安格迎战Triple H，卫冕WWF世界重量级冠军，以及克里斯·杰里科在梯子赛击败洲际冠军克里斯·班瓦。

en.s: 2000 Empress's Cup Final was the 22nd final of the Empress's Cup competition. The final was played at National Stadium in Tokyo on January 21, 2001. Nippon TV Beleza won the championship.

zh.s: 2001年1月21日，第22届皇后杯决赛在东京国立竞技场举行。日本电视台贝雷扎队夺得冠军。

en.s: An earthquake struck the Pacific Coast of Mexico on 21 January 2003 with a moment magnitude of 7.5. It had a maximum Mercalli intensity of VIII (Severe). The epicenter was located on the Pacific coast near the Mexican state of Colima. The earthquake killed 29 people, injured 1,073 others and damaged over 43,300 homes across five states, with minor damage also occurring in Mexico City.

zh.s: 2003年1月21日，墨西哥太平洋沿岸发生矩震级7.5级地震，最高烈度达到麦加利烈度VIII级（严重）。震中位于太平洋沿岸、靠近科利马州。地震造成29人死亡、1073人受伤，五个州有超过43300所房屋受损，墨西哥城也有轻微损坏。

en.s: Miyazaki Prefecture held a gubernatorial by-election on January 21, 2007. Former governor Tadahiro Ando was arrested for bid-rigging. Independent comedian Hideo Higashikokubaru (running under the name "Higashi Sonomanma") won.

zh.s: 宫崎县于2007年1月21日举行知事补选。前知事安藤忠恕因投标串通案被捕。独立候选人、喜剧演员东国原英夫（以“东国原Sonomanma”为名参选）当选。

en.s: The 2009 Democratic National Committee chairmanship election was held in Washington, D.C. on January 21, 2009, at the party's winter meeting to determine the next chairperson of the Democratic National Committee (DNC). The chair election was uncontested, and Tim Kaine was elected chairperson, succeeding Howard Dean.

zh.t: 2009年美国民主党全国委员会主席选举
zh.s: 2009年1月21日，民主党在华盛顿特区举行冬季会议，选举下一任全国委员会主席。选举没有竞争，蒂姆·凯恩当选，接替霍华德·迪安。

en.t: Steven Chu sworn in as US energy secretary
en.s: On January 21, 2009, physicist and Nobel laureate Steven Chu was sworn in as United States secretary of energy in Barack Obama’s administration.

zh.t: 朱棣文宣誓就任美国能源部长
zh.s: 2009年1月21日，物理学家、诺贝尔奖得主朱棣文宣誓就任美国能源部长，加入贝拉克·奥巴马政府。

en.t: Operation Dawn of Gulf of Aden
en.s: Operation Dawn of Gulf of Aden (Korean: 아덴만 여명 작전) was a naval operation by the Republic of Korea Navy against Somali pirates in the Arabian Sea. The operation was spurred by the pirates' seizure of the South Korean chemical tanker Samho Jewelry. In response, the South Korean government sent a destroyer and 30 naval commandos to retake the ship and rescue its crew. After trailing the tanker for several days and fighting a preliminary engagement that neutralized four of the pirates, the South Korean forces retook the ship by force on January 21, 2011, in a successful boarding action that resulted in the deaths of eight and the capture of five out of thirteen pirates.

zh.s: “亚丁湾黎明行动”（韩语：아덴만 여명 작전）是韩国海军在阿拉伯海针对索马里海盗开展的一次海上行动。此前，海盗劫持了韩国化学品油轮“三湖珠宝号”。韩国政府随后派出一艘驱逐舰和30名海军突击队员，准备夺回船只并解救船员。韩国军方跟踪油轮数日，并先与海盗交火，击伤4人。2011年1月21日，韩国部队强行登船并夺回油轮；行动中13名海盗有8人死亡、5人被俘。

en.t: Adelaide United FC 8–1 North Queensland Fury FC
en.s: The 2010–11 A-League match between Adelaide United and North Queensland Fury at Hindmarsh Stadium, Adelaide, took place on Friday, 21 January 2011. Adelaide United won 8–1, which at the time was the biggest win in the history of the competition. North Queensland Fury disbanded at the end of the season, after finishing bottom of the table, whereas Adelaide United finished 3rd in the regular season, qualifying for the AFC Champions League qualifying play-off, and reaching the semi-finals of the finals series.

zh.t: 阿德莱德联8比1大胜北昆士兰怒火
zh.s: 2010—11赛季澳大利亚职业足球联赛中，阿德莱德联队与北昆士兰怒火队的比赛于2011年1月21日星期五在阿德莱德欣德马什体育场举行。阿德莱德联以8比1获胜，当时创下该联赛最大比分胜利纪录。北昆士兰怒火在赛季结束、排名垫底后解散；阿德莱德联在常规赛排名第三，获得亚冠资格赛席位，并晋级季后赛半决赛。

en.s: The 2012 South Carolina Republican presidential primary took place on January 21, 2012. The primary has become one of several key early state nominating contests in the process of choosing the nominee of the Republican Party for the election for President of the United States.

zh.t: 2012年美国共和党南卡罗来纳州总统初选
zh.s: 2012年1月21日，共和党在南卡罗来纳州举行总统初选。该州初选已成为美国共和党决定总统候选人过程中，数场关键的早期州级角逐之一。

en.s: The 2013 Eritrean Army mutiny was mounted on 21 January 2013, when around 100-200 soldiers of the Eritrean Army in the capital city, Asmara seized the headquarters of the state broadcaster, EriTV, and allegedly broadcast a message demanding reforms and the release of political prisoners. The mutiny was the first major incident of resistance to the rule of Isaias Afewerki since the purging of a group of fifteen ministers who demanded political reform in 2001. Details about the mutiny remain murky, with several (but not all) government officials denying it even took place, while opposition sources claimed it had been an abortive coup attempt.

zh.s: 2013年1月21日，约100至200名厄立特里亚士兵，在首都阿斯马拉占领国家电视台EriTV总部，据称播出要求改革及释放政治犯的信息。这是2001年15名要求政治改革的部长遭清洗以来，首次大规模反抗伊萨亚斯·阿费沃尔基统治的事件。兵变细节仍不清楚，一些但并非所有政府官员甚至否认发生过此事；反对派消息则称，这是一次失败的政变。

en.s: The Battle of Diabaly was fought between government forces of Mali, against groups of Islamists militants such as the AQIM and Ansar Dine. The Islamists held control of Diabaly for no longer than a week until Malian forces with the help French air strikes recaptured the town.

zh.s: 迪亚巴利战役的交战双方是马里政府军和伊斯兰武装团体，包括“伊斯兰马格里布基地组织”和“伊斯兰卫士”。伊斯兰武装分子控制迪亚巴利不超过一周，随后马里军队在法国空袭支援下夺回该镇。

en.t: Syrian army counterattacks in Deir ez-Zor
en.s: On 21 January 2016, the Syrian army launched a counteroffensive against the Baghiliya district of Deir ez-Zor, Syria. ISIL had begun its offensive on January 16 and advanced in the preceding days.

zh.t: 叙利亚军队在代尔祖尔反攻
zh.s: 2016年1月21日，叙利亚军队向代尔祖尔的巴吉利亚区发起反攻。“伊斯兰国”武装自1月16日发动攻势后，已在当地推进数日。

en.t: 2015 Sheikh Jassim Cup played in Doha
en.s: On 21 January 2016, the match for the 2015 Sheikh Jassim Cup took place at Jassim bin Hamad Stadium in Doha, Qatar. Lekhwiya, now known as Al-Duhail, defeated Al Sadd 4–1.

zh.t: 2015年谢赫贾西姆杯在多哈举行
zh.s: 2016年1月21日，2015年谢赫贾西姆杯比赛在卡塔尔多哈的贾西姆·本·哈马德体育场举行。莱赫维亚（今杜海勒）以4比1击败萨德。

en.s: On January 21, 2017, Bellator 170: Ortiz vs. Sonnen took place at The Forum in Inglewood, California, United States. Spike TV broadcast the mixed martial arts event live in prime time.

zh.s: 2017年1月21日，Bellator第170期“奥尔蒂斯对索南”综合格斗赛在美国加利福尼亚州英格尔伍德的The Forum场馆举行。Spike电视台在黄金时段直播了赛事。

en.t: 2018 New Democratic Party of Quebec leadership election
en.s: The New Democratic Party of Quebec (2014) elected a permanent leader on January 21, 2018 to lead it into the 2018 provincial election. Interim leader Pierre Ducasse announced he would not be a candidate in the leadership election.

zh.t: 2018年魁北克新民主党党魁选举
zh.s: 魁北克新民主党（2014年成立）于2018年1月21日选出正式党魁，以带领该党参加当年的省级选举。临时党魁皮埃尔·迪卡斯宣布不参加此次党魁选举。

en.s: Blood & Thunder (2022) was a professional wrestling supercard event produced by Major League Wrestling (MLW), which took place on January 21, 2022, at Gilley's Dallas in Dallas, Texas. The event was a television taping for MLW Fusion, and it was the second event under the MLW Blood and Thunder chronology.

en.s: On January 21, 2023, a mass shooting occurred in Monterey Park, California, United States. The gunman killed eleven people and injured nine others. The shooting happened at about 10:22 p.m. PST (UTC-8) at Star Ballroom Dance Studio, after an all-day Lunar New Year Festival was held on a nearby street. Shortly afterwards, the gunman drove north to Lai Lai Ballroom in nearby Alhambra to continue his shooting spree but was confronted by staff and disarmed before fleeing by car.

zh.s: 2023年1月21日，美国加利福尼亚州蒙特雷帕克发生大规模枪击案，枪手杀害11人、打伤九人。太平洋时间约22时22分，星舞厅遭到袭击，附近街道当天刚举行了一整天的农历新年庆祝活动。不久后，枪手驾车北上邻近阿罕布拉的来来舞厅，企图继续开枪，但遭工作人员拦阻并夺走武器，随后驾车逃离。

en.s: On January 21, 2023, KSW held KSW 78: Materla vs. Grove 2, a mixed martial arts event, at Netto Arena in Szczecin, Poland.

zh.s: 2023年1月21日，KSW第78期综合格斗赛在波兰什切青的Netto体育馆举行，主赛为Materla与Grove的第二次交手。

en.s: The 2022 Kosovar Supercup was the 31st edition of the Kosovar Supercup, an annual football match played between the winners of the previous season's Kosovo Superleague and Kosovar Cup competitions. The match was played between Ballkani, champions of the 2021–22 Kosovo Superleague and Llapi, who beat their opponents to win the 2021–22 Kosovar Cup Final. Ballkani won the match 1–0 and claimed their first Supercup title.

zh.s: 2022年科索沃超级杯是第31届赛事。这项年度足球比赛由上赛季科索沃超级联赛冠军对阵科索沃杯冠军。本届参赛队伍是2021—22赛季科索沃超级联赛冠军巴尔卡尼队，以及在科索沃杯决赛中击败对手的拉皮队。巴尔卡尼以1比0获胜，首次夺得超级杯冠军。

en.s: On 21 January 2025, a fire occurred at the Grand Kartal Hotel at the Kartalkaya ski resort in Bolu Province, Turkey; at least 78 people died, 51 others were injured. The fire started in the hotel's fourth floor kitchen/restaurant section. It occurred during the Turkish winter school break, when the hotel was 80–90% full.

zh.s: 2025年1月21日，土耳其博卢省卡尔塔尔卡亚滑雪场的大卡尔塔尔酒店发生火灾，至少78人死亡、51人受伤。火灾从酒店四楼的厨房和餐厅区域开始。当时正值土耳其冬季学校假期，酒店入住率为80%至90%。

en.s: On 21 January 2025, the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) began a large-scale military operation, which it named "Iron Wall", against Palestinian militants in the Israeli-occupied West Bank. Initially, Israel's operation only targeted the Jenin Brigades, a local Palestinian militia in Jenin. On the fourth day, the IDF expanded its activities to Tulkarm and other Palestinian cities and towns.

zh.s: 2025年1月21日，以色列国防军在被以色列占领的约旦河西岸展开大规模军事行动，称为“铁墙行动”。行动最初只针对杰宁当地的巴勒斯坦武装组织“杰宁旅”。第四天，国防军将行动扩大到图勒凯尔姆及其他巴勒斯坦城市和城镇。
